context: Tests whether the solution uses the skill's modern scroll-driven reveal pattern, separates continuous presentation from discrete effects, and contains per-frame geometry work.

checklist.name: Modern position
checklist.description: Uses typed ScrollPosition for semantic or programmatic position on the iOS 26 baseline and does not claim ScrollViewReader is deprecated.

checklist.name: Paged targets
checklist.description: Uses stable targets with scrollTargetLayout and paging or an equivalent modern settling behavior for the primary and details surfaces.

checklist.name: Single progress
checklist.description: Derives one clamped normalized progress value from scroll geometry using onScrollGeometryChange and a small Equatable transform result.

checklist.name: Shared effects
checklist.description: Derives opacity, offset, scale, blur, toolbar treatment, and reveal affordances from the shared progress value.

checklist.name: No mirror flags
checklist.description: Removes or rejects duplicated stored booleans that mirror the same continuous reveal transition.

checklist.name: No parallel drag
checklist.description: Keeps the scroll view as the interaction source of truth and removes or rejects the competing drag state machine.

checklist.name: Discrete effects
checklist.description: Uses visibility callbacks only for deduplicated discrete threshold effects and gates truly settled timing with an idle scroll phase rather than treating visibility as continuous progress or guaranteed rest.

checklist.name: Gesture arbitration
checklist.description: Disables scrolling during conflicting zoom, crop, or precision-editing interactions with scrollDisabled or an equivalent explicit ownership boundary.

checklist.name: Narrow invalidation
checklist.description: Keeps raw geometry and per-frame progress out of broad shared state and limits invalidation to a small presentation subtree.

checklist.name: No feedback loop
checklist.description: Prevents progress-driven presentation from changing the page height, content inset, or other geometry used to calculate progress and stays within layout/component scope.
